title: Hourly Pay Calendar 2026 to 2027
summary: The cut-off dates and paydays for hourly-paid staff from October 2026 to December 2027.
body:
This memo gives hourly-paid staff the cut-off dates and paydays from October 2026 to December 2027. A new calendar is issued each year.

- Each month’s pay covers the hours worked from the **21st of the previous month to the 20th of the current month**. Hours worked after the 20th are paid in the following month.
- Payday is the **last day of the month**, or the **last working day before it** if that day is a weekend or public holiday. The full pay rules are in the Staff Handbook (PEL-POL-001), section 5.1. If you have questions, please speak to Management.

| **Pay month**      | **Hours worked**                    | **Payday**              |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| **October 2026**   | 21 September to 20 October 2026     | Friday 30 October 2026  |
| **November 2026**  | 21 October to 20 November 2026      | 30 November 2026        |
| **December 2026**  | 21 November to 20 December 2026     | 31 December 2026        |
| **January 2027**   | 21 December 2026 to 20 January 2027 | Friday 29 January 2027  |
| **February 2027**  | 21 January to 20 February 2027      | Friday 26 February 2027 |
| **March 2027**     | 21 February to 20 March 2027        | 31 March 2027           |
| **April 2027**     | 21 March to 20 April 2027           | 30 April 2027           |
| **May 2027**       | 21 April to 20 May 2027             | 31 May 2027             |
| **June 2027**      | 21 May to 20 June 2027              | 30 June 2027            |
| **July 2027**      | 21 June to 20 July 2027             | Friday 30 July 2027     |
| **August 2027**    | 21 July to 20 August 2027           | 31 August 2027          |
| **September 2027** | 21 August to 20 September 2027      | 30 September 2027       |
| **October 2027**   | 21 September to 20 October 2027     | Friday 29 October 2027  |
| **November 2027**  | 21 October to 20 November 2027      | 30 November 2027        |
| **December 2027**  | 21 November to 20 December 2027     | 31 December 2027        |

Thank you for your cooperation.

questions.q: What is the monthly cut-off for hourly pay?
options: The last day of the month

questions.q: Payday falls on a weekend or public holiday. When are you paid?
options: On the last working day before it
